releases.notes:
## [1.4.83] - 2026-11-01

- Restore standard Fenrkin shake-off feedback when lingering Wet expires: a brief model shake, water droplets and wolf-shake sound. Add a two-second load-in Wet state when dry while preserving longer saved timers; keep Champion weakness immunity and existing Figura ability flags.

- Enable separate Fabric and NeoForge CurseForge publishing with verified project/dependency IDs, optional integrations and the same loader-specific version names. Link the project from loader metadata.

- Add native texture fallbacks to 76 custom HUDs and 111 tooltip badges. Honor ordered badge fallbacks in the custom Origin menu while keeping hover text and existing artwork.
- Allow datapack-defined, resource-pack-only enhanced sound layers without Spell Engine. Support custom IDs, volume/pitch and live reload; retain the existing switches, bundled cues and ability costs. Skip invalid sound definitions safely.
- Audit the copied pack for competing Origin/power definitions and asset overrides; preserve intentional Origin-layer merging and existing pack priority.

- Declare supported integrations as optional in loader and publishing metadata, and document their visual, sound, avatar, shader and gameplay hooks on each mod-page description.
- Recognize current More RPG Library (`mrpg_lib`) and resolve legacy enhanced-FX resource IDs to its current namespace, while retaining older-library support and bundled fallbacks.

- Clear the Mortal Resolve Figura active flag when the tracked state ends, including Champion Mortal Triumph expiry. Repair stale inactive flags on login while preserving valid active/reconnecting states.
- Verify standard-Origin cooldown rates, resource costs and temporary-effect recovery with real clients on Fabric and NeoForge.

- Verify all other Champion selections with real Fabric and NeoForge clients, including cooldown recovery, sustained resource costs, exhaustion recovery, Arachne weaving and Gorgon charges. Keep existing standard-Origin balance unchanged.

- Restrict Champion cooldown recovery to 26 explicitly listed ability cooldowns. Internal input, charge, sound, consumption, passive-proc and crowd-control/effect timers retain their normal cadence, and unrelated mods' cooldowns are no longer accelerated.
- Fix doubled dust/channel/wing-charge consumption for Champion Faerie, Lichling and Wyverian; restore Wyverian's normal hover-charge interval. Keep ordinary resource amounts/regeneration and intended ability cooldown reductions unchanged.
- Keep Champion Fenrkin's five-second mark channel with its normal 20-tick channel cadence, since internal timers are now excluded from accelerated recovery. Preserve its 40 stamina, 5-cost directional leaps and 30/60-second effective Mark/Hunt cooldowns.

- Keep Champion Fenrkin's stamina-drain clock separate from accelerated ability cooldowns, fixing Surge consuming stamina about twice as fast as its stated one unit per second.
- Read Champion Fenrkin leap direction two server ticks after activation so simultaneous direction/Jump inputs use the updated held-key state. Recheck the ability and crowd-control state before applying the impulse.
- Improve Champion Fenrkin only: 40 stamina, 5-stamina leaps and reuse after partial recovery instead of waiting for a full refill. Hold Surge and use movement keys with Jump for forward, backward, sideways or diagonal leaps; Jump without movement keys leaps vertically. Preserve discrete jump presses, crowd-control restrictions and the projectile-damage penalty.
- Give Champion Fenrkin up to three caster-owned marks, using Opoli's native synced entity sets. Marks last 90 seconds so three can overlap with the 30-second effective cooldown; retain the five-second marking channel and +25% damage from the marking Champion. Hunt has a 60-second effective cooldown and orange outlines. Standard Fenrkin retains its existing data and balance.

- Show Fenrkin's lingering Wet weakness on the HUD and bind its Wet/cramped counters to explicit power IDs. Verify the native 20% damage penalty, loss of the speed bonus, recovery and Champion exemption on both loaders.
- Add Siren water-hover behavior with sneaking descent, matching Nereid. Restore underwater breathing for standard and Champion Lichlings without a potion effect.
- Restore carved-pumpkin and jack-o'-lantern Gorgon protection through the shared equipment tag. Clear temporary Gorgon petrification on login, death and respawn; manual repair now clears active temporary crowd control while preserving unrelated grants and current health.
- Render petrification desaturation in a dedicated world-only pass, separate from menu rendering and the shared shader-power slot.
- Exempt Convenient Decor umbrellas from iron weakness while retaining iron tools, weather vanes and umbrella stands.
- Add separate base-cooldown lines to ability descriptions using current power values; retain Ravenous Lunge's existing 10-second cooldown.

## [1.4.81] - 2026-10-24

- Fix Origin repair skipping a missing layer grant when the power is still held from another source. Restore multiple-power children under their native parent source; preserve existing resources, cooldowns, unrelated grants and current health.
- Include Champion power paths in outgoing-Origin transient cleanup, including Champion Wyverian's breath helpers. Clear Humanity's final-stand timer when Humanity is removed.
- Release offline Humanity/Champion Humanity runtime timer entries while preserving persisted deadlines and finality across reconnects.
- Reduce repeated Webbed orphan-power scans to once per second; normal expiry, death, join and manual repair still clear immediately.
- Reuse the particle-sphere coordinate basis per cast and remove temporary set allocation from Faerie jump checks; preserve existing visuals and jump behavior.

- Expose Logout Diagnostics (Fabric Server) in the existing OP-controlled Fzzy Config screen. The setting defaults off, persists with server config, and applies to existing worlds immediately. Startup JVM flags are no longer used; enabling/disabling is logged.

- Update Overgrown Origins to 1.47.12 and Opoli to 1.119.0 on both loaders. Update client and server dependencies together.
- Cache airborne movement-modifier sums using Opoli's new dirty-invalidated attribute summaries. Preserve legacy stacking, suppression and all five transfer owners.
- Extend opt-in Fabric unload diagnostics to trace nested/off-thread unload entry, including iterator mutations which bypass status-update hooks. Keep the native queue/algorithm and rethrow original failures; the live crash cause remains unconfirmed.

releases.notes:
## [1.4.80] - 2026-10-13

- Clear temporary Arachne Webbed state on login, death and respawn, and remove orphaned restraint grants. Expired or missing Webbed timers cannot leave the player permanently immobilized. Manual `/andromedaorigins repair <player>` also releases stuck Webbed state without healing or deleting player data.

- Clean Andromeda attribute modifiers after the final power grant is removed, preventing temporary speed boosts, slowdowns and petrification attack-speed locks from persisting. Preserve remaining grants and avoid healing on removal.

- Harden Webbed/restraint: cap jumping at zero instead of a negative value, disable unnecessary health updates for its movement-speed modifier, and clear revoked restraint speed modifiers after expiry. Add OP-only `/andromedaorigins diagnose_web <player>` for server health, movement and restraint state when investigating NaN reports.

- Fix standard and Champion Arachne wall-climbing hold being enabled while standing instead of crouching.
- Restore Webbed's two screen-overlay textures with a soft white vignette, a transparent center, and correct packaged paths, fixing the full-screen missing-texture effect on victims. Validate local overlay references during resource checks.
- Prevent a normal ground-jump press from also spending a standard or Champion Faerie air-jump charge after takeoff. A separate airborne press still activates the existing air jump.

- Clear orphaned Nereid Wet grants after hydration helpers disappear or expire, fixing infinite land breathing with an empty hydration reserve. Preserve valid hydration, breathing effects, and unrelated Wet sources.

- Fix Lichling sunlight slowness persisting at night or under shelter after its helper power is revoked. Automatically clear stuck sunlight speed modifiers while preserving the 35% sunlight penalty and other mods' attributes.

- Enforce expired Nereid hydration air drain after server player updates, preventing later air recovery from undoing land suffocation. Preserve native client prediction, Respiration, suppression, water/rain, Water Breathing (including diving helmets), and Conduit Power; resume draining when protection ends.
- Fix Nereid Submersion pulling only fully submerged targets, its drowning drain being overwritten by player updates, and its hydration HUD appearing on non-Nereid victims.
